worldWarI.description: In June 1914, Archduke Franz Ferdinand, heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne, was assassinated in Sarajevo. A single shot set off a chain of events that would plunge the world into war. But who were the key players behind this global conflict? Predict the alliances that will shape history. Use the clue cards whenever you need help.

questions.question: Which country do you think will stand by Austria-Hungary first in 1914?

totalClues.clue: This country is known for Volkswagen cars, the Gutenberg press, and the Brothers Grimm fairy tales.
totalClues.feedback: Yes! After Archduke Ferdinand's assassination, Germany promised Austria-Hungary full support, aiming to defeat France before Russia mobilised.

questions.question: Which 5 nations will support Serbia in the conflict?

totalClues.clue: This huge, cold country is famous for its winter snow, having a king called the Tsar, and fighting Napoleon long ago.
totalClues.feedback: Yes! Russia mobilised its army to defend Serbia after Austria-Hungary declared war on Serbia.

totalClues.clue: Bonjour! This country built the Louvre Museum, invented cinema, and its people once stormed the Bastille prison!
totalClues.feedback: Yes! France entered World War I when Germany declared war on it, as France was supporting its ally, Russia.

totalClues.clue: This island nation is known for Big Ben, the Royal Family, and an empire where the sun never sets.
totalClues.feedback: Yes! The UK joined the war because Germany invaded Belgium, which it had promised to protect, and to help its allies, France and Russia.

totalClues.clue: This country is famous for crispy waffles and is home to the European Union headquarters.
totalClues.feedback: Yes! Belgium entered the war as Germany invaded Belgium in 1914, breaking the treaty that had guaranteed Belgian neutrality since 1839.

totalClues.clue: This Asian island nation is famous for samurai warriors, Mount Fuji, volcanic mountains, and created the game Pokémon.
totalClues.feedback: Yes! Japan joined the war because it was the UK’s ally and wanted to capture German-controlled territories in Asia.

questions.question: A new ally joins Germany and Austria-Hungary! Which is this nation ?

totalClues.clue: This empire was famous for its sultans, delicious baklava pastries, and the legendary city of Constantinople.
totalClues.feedback: Yes! Ottoman Turkey officially joined the Central Powers to recover lost lands and counter Russia. German support and promises of help against rivals also played a major role.

worldWarI.description: The war takes a darker turn in 1915 as smoke fills the air, trench lines deepen, and new weapons shift the tides of battle. Which nations will tip the balance this year?

questions.question: Which country joined the war in 1915 to support Serbia and its allies?

totalClues.clue: This boot-shaped country is famous for pasta, pizza, and the Leaning Tower of Pisa.
totalClues.feedback: Yes! Italy joined the Allied Powers because it was promised territorial gains, including Italian-speaking lands controlled by Austria-Hungary, which Italy wanted to expand its borders.

questions.question: A Balkan country joined team Central Powers in 1915. Can you spot the new ally on the map?

totalClues.clue: This Balkan country, with a Black Sea coast, is named after an ancient tribe and is known for its yogurt and Cyrillic script.
totalClues.feedback: Yes! Bulgaria joined the Central Powers to regain land lost to Serbia in earlier Balkan Wars and gain access to the Aegean Sea.

worldWarI.description: The walls stand scarred but unbroken in 1916-just like the armies locked in endless combat. Who will break first?

questions.question: Two nations break their silence in 1916. Can you discover who joins the Allied Powers?

totalClues.clue: Motherland of football star Cristiano Ronaldo, this country sits at Europe’s western edge where Vasco da Gama began his voyage.
totalClues.feedback: Yes! Portugal joined the Allies to protect trade routes, colonies, and honour its alliance with Britain.

totalClues.clue: This country is famous for the legend of Dracula, traditional folk dances, and shares its name with the ancient Romans.
totalClues.feedback: Yes! Romania joined the Allies to gain Transylvania from Austria-Hungary and expand its borders.

worldWarI.description: Thunder rolls in 1917. An empire breaks apart from within. Across stormy seas, a sleeping giant awakens and sets sail. The war will never be the same. Who changes the course of history?

questions.question: The tide shifts in 1917. Two nations answer the call. Who crosses the seas to fight?

totalClues.clue: This country is home to the Statue of Liberty, gifted Disney and jazz music to the world, and was the first nation to put a man on the Moon.
totalClues.feedback: Yes! The USA joined due to German submarine attacks (including the Lusitania), the Zimmermann Telegram revealing German-Mexico plans, and economic ties with the Allies.

totalClues.clue: This country is the birthplace of democracy, the Olympic Games, and gave the world, great philosophers like Socrates and Plato.
totalClues.feedback: Yes! Greece joined the Allies after internal conflict between pro-Allied Prime Minister Venizelos and pro-German King Constantine, who eventually abdicated under Allied pressure.

worldWarI.description: The thunder fades to whispers. Four years of relentless battle ends not with glory, but with exhaustion. Ancient empires crumble like forgotten ruins. As silence falls in November, the world holds its breath. What emerges from the ashes?

questions.question: Torn apart by chaos, one empire exits early. Who withdrew in 1918?

totalClues.feedback: Russia left the war in 1918 after the Bolshevik Revolution brought Lenin to power. Facing massive losses, Russia signed the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk with Germany in 1918.
By late 1918, the Central Powers surrendered one by one—Bulgaria, the Ottoman Turkey, Austria-Hungary, and Germany—ending World War I.
